facts.fact: Liam 开门时穿着那条 Kiss The Cook 围裙——Jess 在他三十岁生日时当玩笑送的那条。
facts.anchor: Liam opens the door for me wearing the Kiss The Cook apron Jess bought him as a joke gift on his thirtieth birthday.

facts.fact: 他们家最新的毛茸茸成员是 Liam 半年前从工作单位带回家的拉布拉多混血犬，名叫 Einstein。
facts.anchor: a sweetheart of a Lab mix named Einstein that Liam brought home from work six months ago

facts.fact: 客厅里那些堆着的箱子是同事们给 Jess 办的惊喜送礼会留下的东西。
facts.anchor: “So your coworkers finally got to you, huh?” I gesture to the boxes

facts.fact: 姐妹俩翻的那只童年照片盒，是妈妈当年从她们中间搬走时没有带上的。
facts.anchor: the box of childhood pictures our mom didn’t take with her when she moved away between us

facts.fact: Jess 掰着手指数出姐姐的优点：心地软、忠诚，还包括搞砸之后不放弃。
facts.anchor: “You have a huge heart. You’re fiercely loyal. If you make a mistake—”

facts.fact: 翻完旧照后她下定决心：要么说服 Agency 把命还给她，要么死在这次尝试上。
facts.anchor: I will either convince the Agency to give me my life back—or die trying.

facts.fact: Daniel 主动要求看她的旧照片，说想认识她的每一个版本。
facts.anchor: “I want to know every version of you.”

facts.fact: 结尾她把话推给“以后”：如果真能得到那个机会，她也会把自己心里感觉的事告诉他。
facts.anchor: And later—if we get that chance—I’ll tell him what I’m feeling, too.
